note: Scenes from circumstance (owner, Oct 27, 01:30 Eastern: 'if the circumstances are right in the simulation, they should be callable, and the English engine handles the words'). Each row is a kind of circumstance: a record of one of its kinds is written somewhere in the world, the player is at a kind of place that day, and someone there has a reason from the record to bring it to them. The producer (src/director/circumstance.ts) reads only the day's new records, casts the person with the highest score (a reason from the record, the player's tie to them, their sociability; the record id breaks a tie; nothing is drawn by chance), and writes a moment for the player labeled circumstance:<id>, which the situation type's cause of the same label stages through the ordinary scheduler. Rows hold no sentence. The four scene-web fields are recordKinds (trigger record kind), place (place kind), cast (cast rule) and outcome (the record the scene writes back). pool: where the cast comes from (named: the people the record names; witnessed: those who saw or read it; household-of-named: the household of the first person it names; civic:<fill>: a civic role the record's bill or body names; new-coworker: a job started today at the player's employer). where: what places the cast with the player (same-town, same-employer, same-household, same-body, known: the player knows them, pool: the pool's own record places them there). player: what must hold of the player (anyone, resident: neither serving nor filed, public-figure: serving or filed, serving: holds an office, voted-on-it: the record's source vote names them, same-body: serves in the body of the record's bill, heard-it: the player is among those who saw or heard the record). recordIdPrefix picks one producer's records among a kind several write (the interest groups' lobbying cases, case:lobby:, among the cases made). everyParameter: the fewest days between two scenes of this row (Wildermyth pacing: scenes cluster where records give cause, quiet otherwise).

rows.cast: a resident who read the paper's story on a vote the player cast, scored on reason, tie and sociability
the resident a law in force reached (a price it moved, a rule they now live under), scored on tie and sociability
a member of the player's body who sat on the committee that heard a bill, scored on tie and sociability
a reporter covering the player's body after a bill dies in committee, scored on tie and sociability
the member of the player's body who introduced a bill, asking the player to carry it with them
a resident who gave money to a cause group that day, asking the officeholder or candidate for their support
a resident who read that a law took effect, stopping the officeholder or candidate in the street, scored on reason, tie and sociability

the day after a party's chair asked the player to run, the seated officeholder of that party who took the player under their wing on the ask (the party mentorship record), who weighs in on whether to run
a resident who read the paper's story that the player took a bribe and who knows the player, asking to their face whether it is true, scored on tie and sociability
on the last day of the player's school year as a senior, someone who attended the same school that year, scored on tie and sociability
a resident who opened their door to the player's own canvass for the first time, the one whose agreement with the player's platform, for or against, is the day's strongest
a resident the player's canvass has knocked on before, who opens the door again, the one whose agreement with the player's platform, for or against, is the day's strongest

a resident who opened their door to the player's own canvass while the player's petition circulates, the one whose agreement with the player's platform, for or against, is the day's strongest; the campaign engine asked them to sign, and the record says whether they did
the sponsor of a bill whose veto override failed, asking a member who voted no or stayed out (the record lists the most movable first) for the next try
